capabilities: Add, connect, and rename blocks by dragging shapes and connector handles
Spawn a new connected block by dropping an arrow on empty space, or splice one into an existing arrow
Multi-select blocks with a marquee or Shift-click for bulk move, reshape, duplicate, and delete
Generate Mermaid code with a live rendered preview that updates in real time
Persist block positions in a %% mv: comment so reopening restores the canvas
extras: The About section says the plugin was built with Claude's help; installed manually it goes under the folder mermaid-visual.
intentEvidence: Hover any rendered mermaid block in a note and click the pencil button to edit it visually.
motivation: The author, a self-described designer, built it after realizing that making a visual chart in Obsidian required writing code, hoping to help others who want a visual tool.
problem: Writing Mermaid diagram code by hand in Obsidian is unnatural for people who think visually rather than in code.
summary: Visual editor that builds Mermaid flowcharts by dragging blocks and connectors on a canvas and generating the Mermaid code.
